label: Wiper motor failure or sticking
symptom: Front and rear wiper motors fail permanently or wipers stick mid-screen due to a faulty motor or perished wiring.
inspection_advice: Test front and rear wipers on all speeds.
notes: Mentioned for general model and specifically for 2.0_16V.

label: Engine oil leaks from non-solidifying sealant
symptom: Oil leaks develop over time as the factory-applied non-solidifying sealant degrades.
fix: Reseal with appropriate gasket maker or solid gasket
warning_signs: ["Oil spots under car", "Low oil level", "Burning oil smell"]
inspection_advice: Inspect engine for oil seepage, especially around sump and timing cover.
